subject: learning/runner-deadline-test-clock
statement: The verb runner separates its existing timeout, termination grace, and exit acknowledgment policy into waitForExit. Virtual-time tests check no signal before the deadline, TERM at expiry, KILL after grace, immediate caller cancellation, and no return before process exit. Real subprocess tests cancel after readiness and retain result classification and cleanup assertions.
intent: Verify deadline behavior independently of process startup speed and host scheduling.
rationale: Elapsed-time bounds mixed timer policy with operating-system scheduling. The production timeout values and signal policy are preserved; testing/synctest exercises boundary transitions while readiness signals coordinate actual processes.
